title: The rains are late
body: It's planting season but the sky has stayed dry for two weeks longer than usual. Your growing crops are stressed.

choices.label: Pay for emergency water trucking (₦8,000)
choices.resultText: A water truck saved the crop from the worst of it.

choices.label: Wait it out
choices.resultText: The dry spell set your crop back a little.

title: Flash flood!
body: Heavy rain overnight flooded your lowest plot. Workers are already out there with buckets.

choices.label: Pay for emergency drainage work (₦12,000)
choices.resultText: The drainage crew got the water out before real damage was done.

choices.label: Let the water find its own way out
choices.resultText: The standing water left the soil in bad shape.

title: Windstorm flattens part of a plot
body: A sudden windstorm tore through overnight, flattening stalks on one of your growing plots.

choices.label: Send workers to prop up what's left (costs Energy)
choices.resultText: Hard work saved most of the crop.

choices.label: Assess the damage later
choices.resultText: Without quick attention, the damage spread.

title: Harmattan dust settles in
body: The dry harmattan wind is coating everything in dust, and your crops are drinking more water than usual.

choices.label: Water by hand (costs Energy)
choices.resultText: A bit of extra effort kept the crop healthy.

choices.label: Let the crop tough it out
choices.resultText: The dust and dryness took a toll.

title: A perfect rain spell
body: Steady, gentle rain fell for three days straight — exactly what your growing crops needed.

choices.label: Enjoy the free boost
choices.resultText: Your crops are looking lush.

title: Fall armyworm spotted
body: A neighbour's farm has fall armyworm, and scouts say it's heading your way.

choices.label: Spray immediately (₦10,000)
choices.resultText: Quick spraying stopped the worm in its tracks.

choices.label: Hope it passes you by
choices.resultText: It didn't pass you by. The crop took real damage.

title: Locusts on the horizon
body: A swarm has been seen two villages over. Farmers are banging pots and lighting fires to scare them off.

choices.label: Hire extra hands to scare them off (₦9,000)
choices.resultText: The noise and smoke kept the swarm moving past your land.

choices.label: Stay indoors and hope
choices.resultText: The swarm settled for a day. Some damage is done.

title: Quelea birds descend on the grain
body: A cloud of quelea birds has found your field at the worst possible time.

choices.label: Pay boys with catapults to scare them (₦5,000)
choices.resultText: The birds moved on to easier pickings.

choices.label: Let them feed
choices.resultText: The birds had a good meal at your expense.

title: Rats in the store
body: You find gnaw marks on your stored produce this morning.

choices.label: Buy traps and bait (₦4,000)
choices.resultText: The traps caught most of them before more damage was done.

choices.label: Deal with it later
choices.resultText: The rats had the run of the store for days.

title: Weevils in the grain store
body: Some of your stored grain is showing the telltale holes of a weevil infestation.

choices.label: Fumigate immediately (₦7,000)
choices.resultText: Fumigation stopped the spread.

choices.label: Sort through it yourself (costs Energy)
choices.resultText: You saved most of it, but it took a toll.

title: Thieves in the night
body: You wake to find part of your store has been raided overnight.

choices.label: Report to the village head and tighten security (₦6,000)
choices.resultText: The village head promised to keep an eye out.

choices.label: Say nothing and move on
choices.resultText: Word gets around that your farm is an easy target.

title: Cattle in the field
body: A herder's cattle have strayed onto your land and grazed down part of a growing plot overnight.

choices.label: Talk it through with the herder, ask for compensation
choices.resultText: The herder apologised and paid something toward the damage.

choices.label: Build a quick fence to stop it happening again (₦9,000)
choices.resultText: The fence should keep cattle out going forward.

title: The youths want "something small"
body: A group of community youths stop by, hinting that a "settlement" would keep things smooth for your farm.

choices.label: Pay them off (₦7,000)
choices.resultText: They leave satisfied, and word of your generosity spreads.

choices.label: Politely refuse
choices.resultText: They leave unhappy. That could come back around.

title: A boundary dispute
body: A neighbour claims your fence line crosses onto their land.

choices.label: Hire a surveyor to settle it properly (₦15,000)
choices.resultText: The survey proved your boundary was correct, and it's now on record.

choices.label: Argue it out yourself
choices.resultText: A tense afternoon, with nothing really resolved.

title: Fuel prices spike
body: News on the radio: fuel prices have jumped overnight, and everything that depends on transport just got pricier.

choices.label: Absorb the cost this season
choices.resultText: It stings, but the farm carries on.

title: The naira slides again
body: Another currency devaluation means imported fertiliser and chemicals cost more this month.

choices.label: Note it and budget around it
choices.resultText: You tighten the belt a little this season.

title: A buyer comes looking
body: A trader passing through town is paying premium cash for farm produce today — no haggling required.

choices.label: Sell her a share on the spot
choices.resultText: Quick, easy cash, no stress.

choices.label: Hold out for your usual market
choices.resultText: You stick to your plan.

title: Import ban lifts local prices
body: Government has banned a key import, and local produce prices are climbing as a result.

choices.label: Good news for the farm
choices.resultText: A welcome bit of extra income this season.

title: Family needs help
body: A relative calls asking for help with a school fee emergency.

choices.label: Send what you can (₦10,000)
choices.resultText: Family is pleased, and word of your generosity travels.

choices.label: Explain the farm can't spare it right now
choices.resultText: It's an uncomfortable call, but the cash stays in the business.

title: A politician wants a photo
body: A local politician's team asks to use your farm for a campaign photo, promising "good things" in return.

choices.label: Let them come through
choices.resultText: Useful contacts, but some neighbours grumble about the association.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.resultText: You keep the farm out of politics.

title: An NGO offers free training
body: An agricultural NGO is running a free training session nearby on modern farming techniques.

choices.label: Attend (costs a day's Energy)
choices.resultText: You picked up a few techniques worth knowing.

choices.label: Skip it, too busy
choices.resultText: Maybe next time.

title: Everything is growing beautifully
body: Conditions have lined up perfectly this season — good sun, good rain, healthy soil.

choices.label: Take the win
choices.resultText: Your crop is thriving.

title: You've been picked for a youth-in-agric grant
body: An NGO programme has selected your farm for a small cash grant.

choices.label: Accept the grant
choices.resultText: A welcome boost to the books.

title: Your farm goes viral
body: Someone posted a video of your farm online, and it's picking up real attention.

choices.label: Enjoy the moment
choices.resultText: New contacts are already reaching out.

title: A neighbour lends a hand
body: Seeing you stretched thin this week, a neighbouring farmer shows up to help with chores, no charge.

choices.label: Gratefully accept
choices.resultText: A good turn, and a friendship strengthened.
